Founded in 1990 by Stefan Håkans, Inter has a rivalry with [[Turun Palloseura]]. The club has won one [[List of Finnish football champions#Performance by club|Finnish championship title]], three [[Finnish Cup]] titles, and four [[Finnish League Cup]] titles.
